lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cu3Ag crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a 12-atom unit cell (Cu9Ag3) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both Ag and Cu centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Ag centers are surrounded by 9 Cu and 3 Ag neighbors (distances 2.808–3.265 Å), while Cu centers show 12 Cu neighbors (2.745–2.935 Å) or mixed 10 Cu/2 Ag (2.811–3.265 Å). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Cu–Cu 12-vertex polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing, while Ag–Cu polyhedra share corners and edges.
